title: HB356 (2020 Regular): Crimes - Firearms - Penalties and Procedures (Violent Firearms Offender Act of 2020)

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Maryland) (gun-policy Stage 5, Maryland); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Mississippi text (First Reader; official copy, https://mgaleg.maryland.gov/2020RS/bills/hb/hb0356f.pdf)
provenance.note: First reader (bill as filed); no vote recorded, no enrolled text read. Large file, read in full. Quote is selected and excerpted (items omitted inside lists); also in the bill: State appeal of excluded evidence extended to gun and Criminal Law §§ 5-621/5-622 cases (Courts § 12-302), mandatory minimums for assault weapon/large magazine and machine gun use (Criminal Law §§ 4-306, 4-404), penalty for § 5-133(b) possession, § 5-138 stolen-gun penalties, § 5-142 and § 5-144 changes, and firearm use as not a 'technical violation' (Correctional Services § 6-101). Pretrial and appeal changes apply only to gun (and violent/drug) crimes, so judged part of the gun subject.
